analyst.summary: ICICI Prudential Life's core insurance metrics -- new-business margin, embedded value, solvency, persistency and profit -- are all improving, helped by a GST exemption on individual life premiums that has driven a sharp jump in high-margin protection sales. The stock has been sold off hard over the past year on sector-wide worries (bancassurance competition, a GST-related cost headwind for the industry), which looks more like a valuation reset than a deterioration in the business itself. We rate it a Hold rather than the model's Sell.
